scene: A glowing photo shows a secret canal behind the city.
picture: A flat side-view along the bazaar wall. Far left stands a hooded stranger holding an amber lantern. Left, strings of drying photographs hang over lines. Center, the curly-haired boy in a denim jacket inspects a glowing canal print pinned to a wooden board. Right, empty display crates sit stacked. Far right, an open stone archway leads out.
shown: a pinned monochrome photograph of a canal boat in the centre
a mysterious hooded stranger holding a lantern on the far left
an open mossy stone archway on the far right
